subject: Physics
note: 35-mark optional Electronics Section B only. Each student's Paper 3 is compulsory 3A (45 marks) PLUS ONE 35-mark option selected from 3BA–3BE, not all options. Original copyrighted question/diagram content is NOT reproduced; this is metadata not student-visible exam practice.
markingWarnings: 01.3 obtains the result from a transistor characteristic curve after a distinct numeric current stage; do not award full marks to a guessed voltage unsupported by the method unless the official scheme explicitly permits it.
01.4 separates current, available charge and a reasoned power/standby comparison.
02.1 is one mark for the entire correct truth-table row set; it cannot be divided into per-row marks.
02.2 depends on labelled circuit schematics and cannot be fully assessed by text-only keyword matching.
02.3 requires logical equivalence with the specified operators, so a generic Boolean expression may not satisfy every mark.
02.5 requires a consequence of the chosen implementation, not a generic 'simpler' claim.
03.3 allows a range in the graph-derived responsivity and consequential marking for calculated photocurrent.
03.4 assigns configuration, ratio and input-label marks to a drawing; a prose-only answer cannot show everything.
04.1 awards independent difference and similarity marks.
04.2 grants method marks for measured waveform timing and handles consequential duty-cycle arithmetic.
04.3 gives independent marks for frequencies of two distinct digital counter designs.
05 is six-mark LEVELS-OF-RESPONSE assessment of several radio transmission routes and explanations, not six disconnected keywords.
